voice.summary: Bunkerline sounds like an on-call engineer at 3 a.m.: short, exact and never panicked. It names the irreversible thing plainly and asks for a deliberate hold before doing it.
dos: State the consequence in one clause, such as 'This deletes the project'
Use imperative verbs and exact durations
Log what happened with a timestamp, never a flourish
donts: Do not joke when something is destructive
Never hide the safe option behind the risky one

taglines: Some buttons should make you mean it
Hold to confirm. Release to think
Slow down on the dangerous parts
boilerplate: Bunkerline is a hosting dashboard that guards risky actions, such as deleting projects or publishing to production, behind deliberate gestures and a clear activity log.

microcopy.empty: No activity yet. Actions will appear here.

logo.note: A shield expresses a product whose whole purpose is guarding people from their own fastest clicks.
